English: This paper examines the language policies and practices in Kenya and Tanzania and argues that, in spite of the observable differences between these neighbouring countries, the ethnic community languages face an uncertain future.
Luganda: Olupapula luno lwekaliriza amateeka n’enkola z’ebyennimi mu ggwanga lya Kenya ne Tanzania era lwoleka nti, newankubadde ng’enjawulo erabika wakati w’amawanga gano ag’omuliraano, ebiseera eby’omu maaso eby’ennimi ennansi si bitangaavu.
Yoruba: Ìwé yìí ń ṣàgbeyẹ̀wò àwọn òfin àti ìṣe èdè ní Kenya àti Tanzania, ó sì tún ṣe ìfilélẹ̀ pé pẹ̀lú bí àwọn ìyàtọ̀ tí wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí láàárín àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tó tira wọn yìí, ọjọ́ iwájú àwọn àwùjọ èdè ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà náà ò dájú.
Zulu: Leli phepha lihlola izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zolimi eKenya naseTanzania futhi lithi, naphezu komehluko obonakalayo phakathi kwalawa mazwe angomakhelwane, izilimi zomphakathi wezinhlanga zibhekene nekusasa elingaqinisekile.
Hausa: Wannan takarda ta yi nazari a kan manufofin harshe da ayyuka a ƙasashen Kenya da Tanzaniya kuma ta yi nuni da cewa, duk da bambance-bambancen da ake iya gani a tsakanin waɗannan ƙasashe maƙwabta, harsunan ƙabilun suna fuskantar makoma marar tabbas.
Northern Sotho: Sengwalwa se se lekola melwana ya dipolelo le ditirišo tša tšona ka Kenya le ka Tanzania gomme se hlagiša gore, ka ntle le diphapano tšeo di bonagalago magareng ga dinaga tše tša boagošane, dipolelo tša ditšhaba tša setlogo di lebane le bokamoso bjo bo se nago le nnete.
Amharic: ይህ ጽሁፍ በኬንያ እና በታንዛኒያ ያሉትን የቋንቋ ፖሊሲዎች እና ተግባራትን የሚፈትሽ ሲሆን በእነዚህ ጎረቤት ሃገራት መካከል የሚታይ ልዩነት ቢኖርም የጎሳ ማህበረሰብ ቋንቋዎች እርግጠኛ ያልሆነ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ እንደሚጠብቃቸው ይገልፃል።

English: Although language policies play a role in determining this future, there are stronger forces that defy language policy, viz. population movements, urbanization, technological changes affecting mass communication, and the structure of the economies.
Luganda: Newankubadde ng’amateeka g’ebyennimi galina kye gakola mu kusalawo ebiseera bino eby’omu maaso, waliwo ebintu eby’amaanyi ebikangazza amateeka g’ebyennimi, okugeza abantu okusenguka, abantu okuva mu byalo ne bagenda mu bibuga, enkyukakyuka mu tekinologiya ezikosa empuliziganya y’abantu, n’ekikula ky’ebyenfuna by’eggwanga.
Yoruba: Bótilẹ̀jẹ́pé àwọn òfin ajẹmédè ń kópa nínú mímọ ọjọ́ iwájú yìí, àwọn ohun tó lágbára ju òfin yìí lọ wà, wọ́n sì ń tako òfin ajemédè, àwọn bíi ìṣínípò ọ̀pọ̀ olùgbé, ìsọ̀gbédìgboro, ìyípadà ẹ̀rọ tó ń ṣàkóbá fún ìbásọ̀rọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀ èèyàn àti ààtò ọrọ̀-ajé.
Zulu: Nakuba izinqubomgomo zolimi zineqhaza ekunqumeni leli kusasa, kunamandla aqinile aphikisana nenqubomgomo yolimi, okungukuthi ukunyakaza kwabantu, ukufudukela kwabantu emadolobheni, izinguquko zobuchwepheshe ezithinta ukuxhumana kwabantu abaningi, kanye nesakhiwo somnotho.
Hausa: Duk da cewa manufofin harshe suna taka rawa wajen tantance wannan makoma, akwai ƙwaƙƙwaran abubuwa waɗanda suka saɓa wa manufofin harshe, wato ƙungiyoyin jama’a da zama birni da sauye-sauyen fasaha da suke shafar sadarwar jama’a da kuma tsarin tattalin arziki.

Yoruba: Ẹ̀dẹ̀ àmúlò gbogbogbò ní èdè tí wọ́n ń lò ní àwọn iléeṣẹ́ ìjọba.
Zulu: Ulimi olusemthethweni ulimi olusetshenziswa emahhovisi kahulumeni.
Hausa: Harshen hukuma shi ne harshen da ake amfani da shi a ofisoshin gwamnati.
Northern Sotho: Polelo ya semmušo ke polelo ye e šomišwago ka dikantorong tša mmušo.
Amharic: ይፋዊ ቋንቋ በመንግስት መስሪያ ቤቶች ውስጥ ጥቅም ላይ የሚውለው ቋንቋ ነው።

English: They said most people spoke Kiswahili but wrote in English.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abantu abasinga obungi baali boogera Oluswayiri naye nga bawandiika mu Lungereza.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé púpọ̀ àwọn èèyàn ń sọ Kiswahili ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ń sàkọsílẹ̀ ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
Zulu: Bathe abantu abaningi bakhuluma isiSwahili kodwa babhala ngesiNgisi.
Hausa: Sun ce yawancin mutane suna jin Kiswahili amma suna rubutu da Ingilishi.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore bontši bja batho ba bolela Kiswahili eupša ba ngwala ka Seisemane.
Amharic: አብዛኞቹ ሰዎች ኪስዋሂሊ ሲናገሩ የሚጽፉት ግን በእንግሊዘኛ ነው ብለዋል።

English: In parliament, most discussions were in Kiswahili, but laws were written in English.
Luganda: Mu lukiiko lw’eggwanga olukulu, okuteesa okusinga kwali kukolebwa mu Luswayiri, naye ng’amateeka gawandiikiddwa mu Lungereza.
Yoruba: Ní ìgbìnmọ̀ àwọn asòfin, púpọ̀ nínú àwọn ìfọ̀rọ̀wérọ̀ wọn wáyé ní Kiswahili, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn òfin jẹ́ kìkọsílẹ̀ ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
Zulu: Ephalamende, izingxoxo eziningi zazingesiSwahili, kodwa imithetho yayibhalwe ngesiNgisi.
Hausa: A majalisa, ana yin yawancin tattaunawa ne da Kiswahili, amma ana rubuta dokoki da Ingilishi.
Northern Sotho: Ka palamenteng, bontši bja dipoledišano di ka Kiswahili, eupša melao yona e ngwadilwe ka Seisemane.
Amharic: በፓርላማ ውስጥ አብዛኛዎቹ ውይይቶች በኪስዋሂሊ ሲሆኑ ህጎች ግን የተጻፉት በእንግሊዘኛ ነው።

English: They said the constitution was the only document that was available in both English and Kiswahili.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ssemateeka w’eggwanga ky’ekiwandiiko kyokka ekyali kifunika mu Lungereza ne mu Luswayiri.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ìwé òfin nìkan ní ìwé-àdéhùn tó wà ní Gẹ́ẹ̀sí àti Kiswahili.
Zulu: Bathe umthethosisekelo yiwona wodwa umqulu otholakala ngesiNgisi nangesiSwahili.
Hausa: Sun ce kundin tsarin mulki shi ne kawai takarda da aka samu a cikin Ingilishi da kuma Kiswahili.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore molaotheo ke sona sengwalwa se nnoši seo se hwetšagalago ka bobedi Seisemane le Kiswahili.
Amharic: በእንግሊዘኛም ሆነ በኪስዋሂሊ ያለው ብቸኛ ሰነድ ህገ መንግስቱ ነው ብለዋል።

English: The Constitution refers to a set of rules that presidents use to rule a country.
Luganda: Ssemateeka kitegeeza ettu ly’amateeka bapulezidenti ge bakozesa okukulembera eggwanga.
Yoruba: Ìwé-òfin ń tọ́ka sí àwọn àkójọ òfin tí àwọn ààrẹ ń lò láti darí orílẹ̀-èdè kan.
Zulu: UMthethosisekelo usho iqoqo lemithetho omongameli abayisebenzisayo ukubusa izwe.
Hausa: Kundin tsarin mulki yana nufin wasu ƙa’idoji da shugabanni suke amfani da su wajen mulkin ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Molaotheo o ra sehlopha sa melao yeo dipresidente di e šomišago go buša naga.
Amharic: ህገ መንግስቱ ፕሬዚዳንቶች ሃገርን ለመምራት የሚጠቀሙባቸውን የህጎች ስብስብ ያመለክታል።

English: The researchers said even in courts of law, people spoke in Kiswahili but judgements and everything else was written in English.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ne mu makooti, abantu baayogeranga mu Luswayiri naye okulamula n’ebintu ebirala byonna byali biwandiikibwa mu Lungereza.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tún sọ pé nínú àwọn ilé-ẹjọ́ gan, àwọn èèyàn ń sọ̀rọ̀ ní Kiswahili ṣùgbọ́n ìdájó àti gbogbo nǹkan míràn jé ìkọsílẹ̀ ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi nasezinkantolo zomthetho abantu bakhuluma ngesiSwahili kodwa izahlulelo nakho konke okunye kubhalwe ngesiNgisi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce ko a kotunan shari’a, mutane suna magana da harshen Kiswahili amma ana rubuta hukunci da komai da Ingilishi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore le ka dikgorotshekong tša molao, batho ba be ba bolela ka Kiswahili eupša dikahlolo le se sengwe le se sengwe di ngwalwa ka Seisemane.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በህግ ፍርድ ቤቶች ውስጥ እንኳን ሰዎች በኪስዋሂሊ ሲናገሩ ፍርዶች እና ሁሉም ነገር ግን በእንግሊዘኛ ተጽፈዋል ብለዋል።

English: Kenya accommodated local languages more than Tanzania, however.
Luganda: Wabula, Kenya yeteekawo omwagaanya gw’ennimi ennansi okusinga Tanzania.
Yoruba: Kenya ṣì tún fàyè gba àwọn èdè ìbílẹ̀ jú Tanzania lọ, síbẹ̀.
Zulu: I-Kenya yazamukela izilimi zendawo ngaphezu kweTanzania, nokho.
Hausa: Duk da haka, ƙasar Kenya ta karɓi harsunan gida fiye da ƙasar Tanzaniya.
Northern Sotho: Kenya e amogetše dipolelo tša ka nageng go feta Tanzania, le ge go le bjale.
Amharic: ኬንያ ግን ከታንዛኒያ በበለጠ ለሃገሬው ቋንቋዎች ቦታ ሰጥታለች።

English: They said in Tanzania kids were taught in Kiswahili for their first 7 years in primary schools, and later on in secondary schools they were taught in English.
Luganda: Baagamba nti mu ggwanga lya Tanzania abaana baali basomesebwa mu Luswayiri mu myaka gyabwe 7 egisooka mu masomero ga pulayimale, ate oluvannyuma ne basomesebwa mu Lungereza mu masomero ga sekendule.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ní Tanzania, wọ́n ń kọ́ àwọn ọmọdé ní Kiswahili fún ọdún 7 àkọ́kọ́ ní àwọn iléèwé àkọ́bèèrè, tó bá wá yá ní àwọn iléèwé girama, wọ́n ń kọ́ wọn ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
Zulu: Bathi eTanzania izingane zazifundiswa ngesiSwahili iminyaka eyi-7 yokuqala ezikoleni zamabanga aphansi, kwathi kamuva ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu zafundiswa ngesiNgisi.
Hausa: Sun ce a Tanzaniya ana koyar da yara a harshen Kiswahili shekaru 7 na farko a makarantun firamare, daga baya kuma a makarantun sakandare ana koyar da su da Ingilishi.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ka Tanzania bana ba be ba rutwa ka Kiswahili mo mengwageng ya bona ya mathomo ye 7 ka dikolong tša phoraemari, gomme ka moragonyana ka dikolong tše di phagamego ba be ba rutwa ka Seisemane.
Amharic: በታንዛኒያ ለመጀመሪያዎቹ 7 ዓመታት በአንደኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤቶች ውስጥ ልጆች በኪስዋሂሊ ሲማሩ በኋላ ደግሞ በሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤቶች በእንግሊዘኛ ይማራሉ ብለዋል።

English: Other local languages were not allowed in schools.
Luganda: Ennimi endala ennansi zaali tezikkirizibwa mu masomero.
Yoruba: Wọn ò gba àwọn èdè ìbílẹ̀ yóókù láàyè ní àwọn iléèwé.
Zulu: Ezinye izilimi zendawo zazingavunyelwe ezikoleni.
Hausa: Ba a yarda da wasu harsunan gida a makarantu ba.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tše dingwe di be di se tša dumelelwa ka dikolong.
Amharic: ሌሎች የሃገሬው ቋንቋዎች በትምህርት ቤቶች ውስጥ አይፈቀዱም።

English: Yet in Kenya, kids were taught in many other local languages during their first 3 years of school.
Luganda: Wabula mu Kenya, abaana baali basomesebwa mu nnimi endala ennansi eziwerako mu myaka 3 egisooka nga bali mu ssomero.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀ ní Kenya, wọ́n ń kọ́ àwọn ọmọdé ní àwọn èdè ìbílẹ̀ púpọ̀ yóókù ní ọdún 3 àkọ́kọ́ wọn ní iléèwé.
Zulu: Nokho eKenya, izingane zafundiswa ngezinye izilimi eziningi zendawo phakathi neminyaka yazo yokuqala emi-3 yesikole.
Hausa: Duk da haka a Kenya, ana koyar da yara a cikin wasu harsunan gida a cikin shekaru 3 na farko na makaranta.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale ka Kenya, bana ba be ba rutwa ka dipolelo tše dingwe tše ntši tša ka nageng mo mengwageng ya bona ye 3o ya mathomo ya ge ba le ka sekolong.
Amharic: በኬንያ ግን በመጀመሪያዎቹ የትምህርት ቤት 3 ዓመታት ልጆች በሌሎች የሃገሬው ቋንቋዎች ይማራሉ።

English: They only started being taught in English from grade 4 onwards.
Luganda: Baatandikanga okusomesebwa mu Lungereza okuva mu kibiina 4 okudda waggulu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ maa ń kọ́ wọn ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì láti ìpẹlẹ 4 lọsíwájú.
Zulu: Baqala ukufundiswa ngesiNgisi kusukela ebangeni lesi-4 kuye phambili.
Hausa: Sai dai an fara koyar da su da Ingilshi tun daga mataki na 4 zuwa gaba.
Northern Sotho: Ba thomile fela go rutwa ka Seisemane go thoma go kreiti ya 4 go tšwela pele.
Amharic: በእንግሊዘኛ መማር የሚጀምሩት ከ4ኛ ክፍል ጀምሮ ነው።

English: The researchers felt that the wide use of Kiswahili in Tanzania in a way overshadowed other local languages.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baawulira ng’okukozesa ennyo Oluswayiri mu Tanzania mu ngeri emu kwabuutikira ennimi endala ennansi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí náà lérò pé ìlò káríilé Kiswahili ní Tanzania ló ṣokùnfà àìmóríyọ àwọn èdè ìbílẹ̀ lápá kan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi banomuzwa wokuthi ukusetshenziswa kakhulu kwesiSwahili eTanzania ngandlela thize kwasibekela ezinye izilimi zendawo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ji cewa yawan amfani da harshen Kiswahili a Tanzaniya ya mamaye wasu harsunan gida.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bile le maikutlo a gore tšhomišo ka bophara ga Kiswahili ka Tanzania go ile gwa gatelela dipolelo tše dingwe tša ka nageng.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በታንዛኒያ ኪስዋሂሊ በስፋት ጥቅም ላይ መዋሉ ሌሎች የሃገሬው ቋንቋዎች በሆነ መንገድ እንደተሸፈኑ ተሰምቷቸዋል።

English: They mentioned that Tanzania started promoting Kiswahili long before Kenya, and this could be the reason why Kenya is more accommodating to more other local languages than Tanzania.
Luganda: Baagamba nti Tanzania yatandika okutumbula Oluswayiri ebbanga ddene nga Kenya tennatandika, era eno yandiba nga y’ensonga lwaki Kenya eteekawo omwagaanya gw’okukozesa ennimi endala ennansi okusinga Tanzania.
Yoruba: Wọ́n mẹ́nubàá pé Tanzania ti ń gbé Kiswahili lárugẹ tipẹ́ kí Kenya tó bẹ̀rẹ̀, èyí sì le jẹ́ ìdí tí Kenya fi gbà àwọn èdè ìbílẹ̀ yóókù láàyè ju Tanzania lọ.
Zulu: Baveze ukuthi iTanzania yaqala ukukhangisa isiSwahili kudala ngaphambi kweKenya, futhi lokhu kungaba yisizathu esenza iKenya izamukele kakhulu zinye izilimi zasendaweni kuneTanzania.
Hausa: Sun ambaci cewa Tanzaniya ce ta fara tallata Kiswahili tun kafin Kenya, kuma wannan na iya zama dalilin da ya sa Kenya ta fi dacewa da wasu harsunan gida fiye da Tanzaniya.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore Tanzania e thomile go tšwetša pele Kiswahili kgale pele ga Kenya, gomme se e ka ba lebaka leo le dirilego gore Kenya e amogele kudu dipolelo tše dingwe tša ka nageng go feta Tanzania.
Amharic: ታንዛኒያ ኪስዋሂሊን ማስተዋወቅ የጀመረችው ከኬንያ በፊት እንደሆነ እና ይህም ኬንያ ከታንዛኒያ ይልቅ ለሌሎች የሃገሬው ቋንቋዎች ምቹ የሆነችበት ምክንያት ሊሆን እንደሚችል ጠቅሰዋል።

English: Most TV and radio stations in Tanzania used Kiswahili more than English, and they were not allowed to use other local languages.
Luganda: TV ne leediyo ezisinga mu Tanzania zaali zikozesa nnyo Oluswayiri okusinga Olungereza, era nga zaali tezikkirizibwa kukozesa nnimi ndala ennansi.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ lára àwọn iléeṣẹ́ amọ́hùn-máwòràn àti àwọn iléeṣẹ́ agbóhùn-sáfẹ́fẹ́ ní Tanzania maa ń lo Kiswahili ju Gẹ̀ẹ́sì lọ, kò dè sí ìgbàláàyè fún àwọn èdè ìbílẹ̀ yóókù.
Zulu: Iziteshi eziningi ze-TV nemisakazo eTanzania zazisebenzisa isiSwahili ngaphezu kwesiNgisi, futhi zazingavunyelwe ukusebenzisa ezinye izilimi zendawo.
Hausa: Yawancin gidajen talabijin da rediyo a Tanzaniya sun fi amfani da Kiswahili fiye da Ingilishi, kuma ba a ba su damar yin amfani da sauran harsunan gida ba.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja dithelebišene le diteše tša radio ka Tanzania di šomiša Kiswahili go feta Seisemane, gomme ga se tša dumelelwa go šomiša dipolelo tše dingwe tša ka nageng.
Amharic: በታንዛኒያ የሚገኙ አብዛኛዎቹ የቴሌቪዥን እና የሬዲዮ ጣቢያዎች ከእንግሊዘኛ ይልቅ ኪስዋሂሊ ሲጠቀሙ ሌሎች የሃገሬውን ቋንቋዎች ግን መጠቀም አይፈቀድላቸውም።

English: Kenya, on the other hand, used mostly local languages, even though newspapers for example, were written in English.
Luganda: Ku ludda olulala, Kenya yali esinga kukozesa nnimi ennansi, newankubadde ng’empapula z’amawulire zaali ziwandiikibwa mu Lungereza.
Yoruba: Kenya, lápá kejì maa ń ṣábà lo àwọn èdè ìbílẹ̀, pẹ̀lú bí àwon ìwé-ìròyìn bí àpẹẹrẹ, jẹ́ kíkọ sílẹ̀ ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
Zulu: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iKenya, yayisebenzisa kakhulu izilimi zendawo, nakuba amaphephandaba ngokwesibonelo, ayebhalwe ngesiNgisi.
Hausa: A ɗaya hannun kuma, a ƙasar Kenya galibi ana amfani da harsunan gida ne, ko da yake jaridu alal misali, ana rubuta su da Ingilishi.
Northern Sotho: Kenya, ka go le lengwe, e šomiša kudu dipolelo tša ka nageng, le ge e le gore dikuranta go fa mohlala, di be di ngwadilwe ka Seisemane.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳን ለምሳሌ ጋዜጦች በእንግሊዘኛ የተጻፉ ቢሆኑም በአንፃሩ ኬንያ በአብዛኛው የሃገሬውን ቋንቋዎች ትጠቀማለች።

English: The researchers however noted that church materials, like bibles, were available in local languages.
Luganda: Wabula abanoonyereza baakyoleka nti ebiwandiiko by’ekkanisa, gamba nga Bbayibuli, byali biwandiikiddwa mu nnimi ennansi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí wá padà fi lélẹ̀ pé àwọn ohun èlò ṣọ́ọ̀ṣì bíi bíbẹ́lì, wà ní àwọn èdè ìbílẹ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi nokho baphawula ukuthi izinto zesonto, njengamabhayibheli, zazitholakala ngezilimi zendawo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun lura cewa kayan coci, kamar Littafi Mai-Tsarki, ana samun su cikin harsunan gida.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale banyakišiši ba lemogile gore dingwalwa tša kereke, tša go swana le dipebele, di hwetšagala ka dipolelo tša ka nageng.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደ መጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ያሉ የቤተ ክርስቲያን ቁሳቁሶች በሃገሬው ቋንቋዎች እንደሚገኙ ጠቁመዋል።

English: They said products in shops were labelled in English in both countries.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ebyamaguzi mu maduuka byali birambiddwa mu Lungereza mu mawanga gombi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní wọ́n forúkọ sí àwọn ọjà ní àwọn ilé ìtajà ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì ní orílẹ̀-èdè méjéèjì.
Zulu: Bathe imikhiqizo yasezitolo ibhalwe ngesiNgisi kuwo womabili la mazwe.
Hausa: Sun ce ana yi wa kayayyakin da suke cikin shaguna alama da Ingilishi a ƙasashen biyu.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ditšweletšwa ka mabenkeleng di leipotšwe ka Seisemane ka mo dinageng tše ka bobedi.
Amharic: በመደብር ውስጥ ያሉ ምርቶች በሁለቱም ሃገራት በእንግሊዘኛ ምልክት ይደረግባቸዋል ብለዋል።

English: Very few products were labelled in both English and Kiswahili.
Luganda: Byamaguzi bitono ebyali birambiddwa mu Lungereza n’Oluswayiri.
Yoruba: Díẹ̀ nínú àwọn ọjà ni wọ́n forúkọ sí ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì àti Kiswahili.
Zulu: Imibalwa kakhulu imikhiqizo ebhalwe ngesiNgisi nangesiSwahili.
Hausa: Samfurori kaɗan ne aka yi wa alama da duka Ingilishi da Kiswahili.
Northern Sotho: Ke ditšweletšwa tše mmalwa fela tšeo di leipotšwego ka bobedi Seisemane le Kiswahili.
Amharic: በእንግሊዘኛም በኪስዋሂሊም ምልክት የተደረገባቸው ምርቶች በጣም ጥቂት ናቸው።

English: They also reported that languages were no longer restricted to certain places because the population was growing and people were mixing.
Luganda: Baayongerako era ne bagamba nti ennimi zaali tezikugirwa mu bifo ebimu kubanga omuwendo gw’abantu gwali gweyongera ate ng’abantu baali beetabika.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣe ròyìn pé òǹdè kankan ò de àwọn èdè sí àwọn ibi kọ̀ọ̀kan mọ́ nítorí àwọn èèyàn ń pọ̀ si, bẹ́ẹ̀ ìwọnúbọ̀nú ń wáyé.
Zulu: Baphinde babika ukuthi izilimi azisanqunyelwe ezindaweni ezithile ngenxa yokuthi inani labantu liyakhula futhi abantu bayaxubana.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun bayar da rahoton cewa, an daina keɓe harsuna a wasu wurare saboda yawan jama'a yana ƙaruwa kuma mutane suna haɗuwa.
Northern Sotho: Ba begile gape gore dipolelo ga di sa bolelwa mafelong a itšego fela ka ge setšhaba se gola ebile batho ba hlakana.
Amharic: የህዝቡ ቁጥር እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ እና ሰዎች እየተቀላቀሉ በመሆናቸው ቋንቋዎች በተወሰኑ ቦታዎች ውስጥ ብቻ አለመገደባቸውንም ዘግበዋል።

English: The researchers suggest that if governments do not change their policies, local languages would be forgotten.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bateesa nti singa gavumenti tezikyusa mateeka gaazo, ennimi ennansi zijja kwerabirwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà dábàá pé tí ìjọba ò bá yí òfin wọn padà, àwọn èdè ìbílẹ̀ máa dohun ìgbàgbé.
Zulu: Abacwaningi basikisela ukuthi uma ohulumeni bengayishintshi imigomo yabo, izilimi zendawo zingalibaleka.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa idan gwamnatoci ba su sauya manufofinsu ba, za a manta da harsunan gida.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišinya gore ge mebušo e sa fetoše melawana ya yona, dipolelo tša ka nageng di tla lebalwa.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ መንግስታት ፖሊሲዎቻቸውን ካልቀየሩ የሃገሬው ቋንቋዎች እንደሚረሱ ጠቁመዋል።

English: In the end, they said it was not clear who, between researchers and the public, should promote local languages.
Luganda: Ku nkomerero, baagamba nti si kitangaavu bulungi ku ani, ku banoonyereza n’abantu aba bulijjo, abasaanye okutumbula ennimi ennansi.
Yoruba: Ní ìgbẹ̀yìn, wọ́n ní kò hàn kedere ẹni tó ye kó gbé àwọn èdè ìbílẹ̀ lárugẹ, yálà àwọn aṣèwádìí tàbí àwọn ará ìlú.
Zulu: Ekugcineni bathe akucaci ukuthi ubani phakathi kwabacwaningi nomphakathi okufanele athuthukise izilimi zakuleli.
Hausa: A ƙarshe, sun ce ba a bayyana wanda, a tsakanin masu binciken da jama'a ya kamata su inganta harsunan gida ba.
Northern Sotho: Mafelelong, ba boletše gore ga go na bonete bja gore ke mang, magareng ga banyakišiši le setšhaba, bao ba swanetšego go tšwetša pele dipolelo tša ka nageng.
Amharic: በመጨረሻም ከተመራማሪዎች እና ከህዝቡ መካከል የሃገሬውን ቋንቋዎች ማን ማስተዋወቅ እንዳለበት ግልፅ አይደለም ብለዋል።

English: And, sadly, perhaps nothing could be done to improve the situation.
Luganda: N’eky’ennaku, oboolyawo tewali kisobola kukolebwa kulongoosa mbeera.
Yoruba: Àti pé kò fẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́ sí ohun tí wón lè ṣe láti ṣàtúnṣe sí ọ̀rọ̀ náà.
Zulu: Futhi, ngokudabukisayo, mhlawumbe akukho okwakungenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo.
Hausa: Kuma, abin baƙin ciki, watakila ba za a iya yin wani abu domin inganta yanayin ba.
Northern Sotho: Gomme, ka maswabi, mohlomongwe ga go seo se ka dirwago go kaonafatša seemo se.
Amharic: እና በሚያሳዝን ሁኔታ ምናልባት ሁኔታውን ለማሻሻል ምንም ነገር ማድረግ አይቻልም።

English: The researchers were based in Kenya and Tanzania.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baali bava mu ggwanga lya Kenya ne Tanzania.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà wà ní Kenya àti Tanzania.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebezinze eKenya naseTanzania.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kasance ne a ƙasashen Kenya da Tanzaniya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba le ka Kenya le Tanzania.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በኬንያ እና በታንዛኒያ የተመሰረቱ ነበሩ።
